dossier.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETP Approval (January 2024)
dossier.claim: The U.S. SEC approved the listing and trading of multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products on January 10, 2024.
dossier.market_question: Did the U.S. SEC approve spot Bitcoin ETPs on January 10, 2024?
dossier.resolution_criteria: Resolve SUPPORTED only if official SEC approval orders or Chair statement confirm approval dated 2024-01-10.

consensus.disagreement_summary: Corroborator and skeptic agreed on SUPPORTED (confidence gap 0.04).

passes.rationale: Primary SEC sources confirm the claim: Chair Gensler's January 10, 2024 statement says the Commission approved listing and trading of multiple spot bitcoin ETP shares that day, and SEC Release No. 34-99306 is the order granting accelerated approval of proposed rule changes to list and trade Bitcoin-based commodity-based trust shares dated January 10, 2024.

citations.title: Statement on the Approval of Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Products
citations.excerpt: Today, the Commission approved the listing and trading of a number of spot bitcoin exchange-traded product (ETP) shares on January 10, 2024.

citations.title: SEC Release No. 34-99306 Self-Regulatory Organizations Order
citations.excerpt: Order Granting Accelerated Approval of Proposed Rule Changes to List and Trade Shares of Bitcoin-Based Commodity-Based Trust Shares dated January 10, 2024.

passes.rationale: Skeptic review found no material contradiction of the claim. The Chair statement dated 2024-01-10 says the Commission approved listing and trading of a number of spot bitcoin ETP shares that day, and SEC Release No. 34-99306 is an official order granting accelerated approval of proposed rule changes to list and trade Bitcoin-based ETP shares, also dated January 10, 2024. Public-evidence search returned those two official records as the only on-point matches. Residual caveats (Chair-statement URL slug 011023; source_id federal-register-34-99306 resolving to an SEC PDF rather than federalregister.gov) do not change the dated approval. Resolution criteria requiring official SEC approval orders or a Chair statement dated 2024-01-10 are therefore met.

probes.name: ProviderError Retries, Timeout & Connection Reuse Policy
probes.detail: Verified http_connection_reuse_enabled=False; HTTP 500 raised ProviderError after 6 attempt(s); slow stub (1.5s vs 1.0s timeout) raised TurnTimeoutError; verified Anthropic (/v1/messages), Cortensor (/api/v2/completions), and OpenAI SSE usage gating.

dx_findings.title: Worktree-Isolated home_root / data_root Containment
dx_findings.observation: `create_isolated_runtime()` bound isolated `home_root` and `data_root` SQLite/agents.json directories (`db_count=14`, `secret_free_config=True`, `run_id=2d700e1618cd402c803fd8c2f68ddb2d`), preventing mutation of developer home state on Windows.

dx_findings.title: Internal Classifiers (FreshnessContract / FinalizationStatus / ClosureJudgment) & Output Coercion
dx_findings.observation: openminion==0.1.21 issues `tool_choice='submit_output'` internal classifier turns (`FreshnessContract`, `FinalizationStatus`, and `ClosureJudgment` where stubs/gateways must preserve `action_summary`). `Agent._coerce_output()` also strips the `f'{agent_id}: '` reply prefix via `_extract_json_object()`, producing typed schema output (`status=OK`, `score=0.99`, `negative_validation_error=True`, `fallback_stub_used=False`).

dx_findings.title: Read-Only @tool Binding & tool_choice='forced' Deterministic Dispatch
dx_findings.observation: Binding `@tool(min_scope='READ_ONLY')` with `tool_choice='forced'` invoked `probe_echo_tag` (call_count=2, forced_invoked=True, invocations=['probe_lookup_fact:cortensor-poi', 'probe_echo_tag:forced-c3']) without filesystem writes.

dx_findings.title: approval_callback Boolean Gate & Fail-Closed approval_callback=None Pause/Resume
dx_findings.observation: `@tool(dangerous=True, min_scope='WRITE_SAFE')` recorded `callback_count=2`, `allow_executed=True`, and `deny_blocked=True`. Passing `approval_callback=None` paused fail-closed (`pause_blocked=True`, `pending_confirmation_id=call-5a36ca6b-fe80-4d14-8500-59e5a01ea5ef-0`) and executed only after `Agent.run('allow_once', session_id=..., thread_id=...)` (`resume_executed=True`).

dx_findings.title: Explicit thread_id Required for Multi-Turn Agent.run(session_id=...) Continuity
dx_findings.observation: Retaining context across turns on the same session required forwarding `thread_id=probe-sess-a-5b958e6d:e44db35cf831436fab48837c1f5f6be8` alongside `session_id`; a distinct session preserved isolation (`same_session_recalled=True`, `second_session_isolated=True`).

dx_findings.title: Cross-Runtime MemoryBundle Export/Import Portability
dx_findings.observation: OpenMinion primitives `export_bundle()`, `save_bundle()`, `load_bundle()`, and `import_bundle()` (wrapped by `export_session_memory()`/`import_session_memory()`) serialized and restored bundle state (`bundle_version=memory_bundle.v1`, `item_count=1`, `invalid_mode_rejected=True`) into a separate APIRuntime SQLite store.

dx_findings.title: Isolated Subagent Passes, task_update Collisions & 90s Timeout Forwarding
dx_findings.observation: Separate subagent runtime sessions avoid `resolve_entry_task_update()` `Missing/Duplicate task_update` crashes (`openminion/modules/brain/loop/context/task_context.py:153-191`) when dispatching sequential passes, while explicit `timeout_seconds` prevents falling back to the `90.0s` default (`context_id=subagent-bf6c16b7d24d`, `parent_transcript_inherited=False`, `tool_allowlist=['probe_subagent_tool']`, `subagent_calls=['subagent-check']`).

dx_findings.title: Peer Handoff Delegation & build_delegate_tool() Timeout/Approval Gap
dx_findings.observation: Peer handoff reached specialist `transfer_to_specialist` (`handoff_invocations=1`, `verbatim_ack=False`). Notably, `openminion/api/handoff.py:169` invokes `handoff.target.run(message)` without caller `timeout_seconds` or `approval_callback`, so target runtimes need explicit `PolicyGrantInput(max_uses=1)` for autonomous confirmation-gated publication.

dx_findings.title: APIRuntime.submit_turn() TurnChunks & TurnTelemetry vs TurnResponse.stats
dx_findings.observation: Collected 12 TurnChunk(s) with `TurnTelemetry(duration_ms=6281, tokens_in=0, tokens_out=0, retries=0, queue_wait_ms=0)` vs `TurnResponse.stats(input_tokens=11841, output_tokens=430)`; `telemetry_metadata_mismatch=True`.

dx_findings.title: Provider Wire Formats, Layered HTTP 500 Retries & http_connection_reuse_enabled=False
dx_findings.observation: With `http_connection_reuse_enabled=False`, HTTP 500 produced 6 attempts (`provider_retry_max_attempts=2` * transport retries) before raising `ProviderError`, and slow responses hit `TurnTimeoutError`. Wire checks verified `AnthropicProvider` (`x-api-key` + `anthropic-version` -> `/anthropic/v1/messages`), `CortensorProvider` (`Bearer` -> `/cortensor/api/v2/completions`), and `OpenAIProvider.stream()` SSE usage gating (`without_vendor=False`, `with_service_vendor_openai=True`).
